# China Backpacking Route & Realistic Budget Plan (8 Destinations) Starting from the travel insights and budget baseline of **Novo-Monde** (*Voyage en Chine: bilan et budget*), here is a realistic, practical, and fully costed backpacking plan across **8 widely recognized destinations** in China. The route is structured as an efficient **Great Loop** connected by China’s high-speed rail (HSR) and overnight sleeper network, minimizing backtracking and maximizing cultural variety, imperial history, food culture, and natural landscapes. --- ## 1. Route Overview: The 8 Destinations (23 Days / 22 Nights) 1. **Beijing** (4 nights / 4.5 days) – *Imperial capital, Great Wall, Forbidden City, historic Hutongs* 2. **Xi'an** (2 nights / 2.5 days) – *Ancient Silk Road capital, Terracotta Army, Muslim Quarter* 3. **Chengdu** (3 nights / 3 days) – *Sichuan cuisine capital, Giant Panda breeding base, teahouse culture* 4. **Chongqing** (2 nights / 2 days) – *The 3D "cyberpunk" mountain megacity, Yangtze River, hotpot* 5. **Zhangjiajie** (3 nights / 3 days) – *Wulingyuan "Avatar" sandstone pinnacles, Tianmen Mountain* 6. **Guilin & Yangshuo** (3 nights / 3.5 days) – *Karst mountain landscapes, Li River & Yulong River bamboo rafting* 7. **Hangzhou** (2 nights / 2 days) – *West Lake UNESCO landscape, Lingyin Temple, Longjing tea plantations* 8. **Shanghai** (3 nights / 3 days) – *Futuristic skyline, The Bund, Yu Garden, modern international exit hub* --- ## 2. Destination Assumptions: Lodging, Food & Activities *(Conversion reference: 1 USD ≈ 7.1 CNY; 1 EUR ≈ 7.7 CNY)* ### Destination 1: Beijing - **Typical Nightly Budget Stay:** - **Dorm bed:** **¥120** (~$17 USD / ~€15.60) per night *(Live evidence: Peking International Youth Hostel in Nanluoguxiang dorms from $25.85 / ~¥180; Beijing Xingshe Youth Hostel dorms from $12.92 / ~¥90; Peking Station Hostel dorms from $27.37 / ~¥195)*. - **Private budget double room:** **¥220** (~$31 USD) per night. - **Low-Cost Daily Food Estimate:** **¥60** (~$8.50 USD / ~€7.80) per day. - *Breakfast:* Jianbing (crispy savory egg crepe) + fresh soy milk: **¥10** - *Lunch:* Zhajiangmian (hand-pulled noodles with fermented soybean paste) or pork baozi: **¥20** - *Dinner:* Jiaozi (boiled dumplings) or home-style stir-fry with rice: **¥30** - **Representative Activities & Sights:** 1. *Forbidden City (The Palace Museum):* **¥60** (Peak: Apr 1 – Oct 31) / **¥40** (Off-peak: Nov 1 – Mar 31). *(Requires passport booking 7 days in advance online).* 2. *Mutianyu Great Wall:* **¥40** entry ticket. *(Public Bus 916 Express from Dongzhimen is ¥12 each way; hiking up the stone steps is free; optional cable car/toboggan return is ¥140).* 3. *Temple of Heaven (Through Combination Ticket):* **¥34** (Peak) / **¥28** (Off-peak). *(Park-only entry: ¥15 / ¥10).* - **Local Transit:** ~¥15/day (Subway Line 1/2/8) = **¥60** for 4 days. - **Beijing 4-Night Subtotal (Dorm Backpacker):** **¥914** (~$129 USD / ~€119) --- ### Destination 2: Xi'an - **Typical Nightly Budget Stay:** - **Dorm bed:** **¥55** (~$7.75 USD / ~€7.10) per night *(Evidence: HanTang Inn Hostel dorms ¥50–70; Xiangzimen Youth Hostel; The Silk Road Hostel)*. - **Private budget double room:** **¥140** (~$19.70 USD) per night. - **Low-Cost Daily Food Estimate:** **¥50** (~$7 USD / ~€6.50) per day. - *Breakfast:* Hulatang (spicy peppery beef vegetable soup) + flatbread: **¥10** - *Lunch:* Biangbiang handmade wide noodles or Roujiamo ("Chinese burger"): **¥18** - *Dinner:* Yangrou Paomo (crumbled flatbread in rich mutton broth) in Muslim Quarter: **¥22** - **Representative Activities & Sights:** 1. *Terracotta Army (Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum):* **¥120** *(includes Pit 1, 2, 3 and the Qin Emperor's Mausoleum park; verified on live attraction page)*. 2. *Xi'an Ancient City Wall:* **¥54** *(rampart access; optional 3-hour bike rental along the top is ¥45)*. 3. *Giant Wild Goose Pagoda & Da Ci'en Temple:* **¥40** *(optional pagoda climb: +¥25; Shaanxi History Museum nearby is Free with advance reservation)*. - **Local Transit:** ~¥12/day (Metro) = **¥24** for 2 days. - **Xi'an 2-Night Subtotal (Dorm Backpacker):** **¥448** (~$63 USD / ~€58) --- ### Destination 3: Chengdu - **Typical Nightly Budget Stay:** - **Dorm bed:** **¥55** (~$7.75 USD / ~€7.10) per night *(Evidence: Flipflop Lounge Hostel; Chengdu Mix Hostel; Dreams Travel Youth Hostel)*. - **Private budget double room:** **¥140** (~$19.70 USD) per night. - **Low-Cost Daily Food Estimate:** **¥50** (~$7 USD / ~€6.50) per day. - *Breakfast:* Steamed baozi, fresh soy milk & tea eggs: **¥8** - *Lunch:* Dan Dan noodles or Zhong dumplings: **¥15** - *Dinner:* Mapo Tofu with rice or street-side chuanchuanxiang skewers: **¥27** - **Representative Activities & Sights:** 1. *Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding:* **¥55** *(arrive early at 7:30 AM when pandas are active)*. 2. *Wuhou Memorial Temple:* **¥50** *(historic Three Kingdoms site; adjacent Jinli Ancient Street is Free)*. 3. *Du Fu Thatched Cottage:* **¥50** *(or People's Park teahouse entry: Free; cup of jasmine green tea: ¥15–25)*. - **Local Transit:** ~¥12/day = **¥36** for 3 days. - **Chengdu 3-Night Subtotal (Dorm Backpacker):** **¥506** (~$71 USD / ~€66) --- ### Destination 4: Chongqing - **Typical Nightly Budget Stay:** - **Dorm bed:** **¥50** (~$7 USD / ~€6.50) per night *(Evidence: Chongqing Loving Youth Hostel; Yangtze River Hostel; Jiefangbei inns)*. - **Private budget double room:** **¥130** (~$18.30 USD) per night. - **Low-Cost Daily Food Estimate:** **¥50** (~$7 USD / ~€6.50) per day. - *Breakfast:* Chongqing Xiaomian (fiery spiced noodle bowl): **¥10** - *Lunch:* Suanlafen (sour & spicy sweet potato noodles): **¥14** - *Dinner:* Shared budget hot pot or street skewers: **¥26** - **Representative Activities & Sights:** 1. *Yangtze River Cableway:* **¥30** round-trip *(¥20 one-way)*. 2. *Hongyadong Stilt House Complex & Jialing River waterfront:* **Free (¥0)** *(best seen illuminated at night)*. 3. *Dazu Rock Carvings (Baodingshan):* **¥115** (Off-peak Dec–Feb) / **¥135** (Peak Mar–Nov). *(Three Gorges Museum in city center is Free)*. - **Local Transit:** ~¥12/day (including the famous Monorail Line 2 passing through the apartment building at Liziba) = **¥24** for 2 days. - **Chongqing 2-Night Subtotal (Dorm Backpacker):** **¥369** (~$52 USD / ~€48) --- ### Destination 5: Zhangjiajie - **Typical Nightly Budget Stay:** - **Dorm bed:** **¥55** (~$7.75 USD / ~€7.10) per night *(Evidence: Zhangjiajie Wulingyuan Youth Hostel; Bajie Youth Hostel; Cloudland Hostel)*. - **Private budget double room:** **¥140** (~$19.70 USD) per night. - **Low-Cost Daily Food Estimate:** **¥55** (~$7.75 USD / ~€7.10) per day. - *Breakfast:* Hunan spicy rice noodle soup: **¥12** - *Lunch:* Packed trail snacks (fresh fruit, trail bread, nuts) inside the park: **¥20** - *Dinner:* Tujia Sanxiaguo (local dry pot stew) or stir-fried noodles: **¥23** - **Representative Activities & Sights:** 1. *Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Wulingyuan):* **¥227** (Peak Mar–Nov) / **¥144** (Off-peak Dec–Feb). *(Includes 4 consecutive days of park admission and all intra-park shuttle buses; Bailong elevator is optional at ¥65 one-way)*. 2. *Tianmen Mountain National Forest Park:* **¥278** *(includes the world's longest mountain passenger cableway, 999 Heaven's Gate steps, and cliffside glass walkway)*. 3. *Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon & Glass Bridge:* **¥128** *(Glass bridge only; full canyon combo ¥219)*. - **Local Transit:** Local public buses connecting Zhangjiajie city, Wulingyuan town, and park gates: ~¥15/day = **¥45** for 3 days. - **Zhangjiajie 3-Night Subtotal (Dorm Backpacker):** **¥1,008** (~$142 USD / ~€131) --- ### Destination 6: Guilin & Yangshuo - **Typical Nightly Budget Stay:** - **Dorm bed:** **¥40** (~$5.60 USD / ~€5.20) per night *(Live evidence: Yangshuo Sudder Street Guesthouse dorms from $4.56 / ~¥32 with swimming pool; This Old Place Xingping dorms from ~¥45; Emoji Hostel from $12.92)*. - **Private budget double room:** **¥100** (~$14.10 USD) per night. - **Low-Cost Daily Food Estimate:** **¥45** (~$6.30 USD / ~€5.80) per day. - *Breakfast:* Guilin Mifen (rice noodles with gravy, fried peanuts, pickled yard-long beans, and sliced meat): **¥8** *(China's top budget breakfast)* - *Lunch:* Fried rice with egg and local seasonal greens: **¥15** - *Dinner:* Yangshuo home-cooked countryside dishes or shared Beer Fish: **¥22** - **Representative Activities & Sights:** 1. *Yulong River Bamboo Rafting:* **¥80** per person *(¥160 total for a 2-person hand-poled raft on the quiet Yulong River)*. 2. *Xingping 20-Yuan Note Viewpoint & Laozhai Mountain Hike:* **Free (¥0)** *(Laozhai Mountain offers a 360° panoramic karst river sunset; Moon Hill is ¥14; Xianggong Mountain is ¥60)*. 3. *Elephant Trunk Hill (Guilin City Landmark):* **Free (¥0)** *(entrance fee abolished in 2022; Reed Flute Cave is ¥70)*. - **Local Transit:** Bicycle / shared e-bike rental & county shuttles: ~¥20/day = **¥60** for 3 days. - **Guilin/Yangshuo 3-Night Subtotal (Dorm Backpacker):** **¥479** (~$67 USD / ~€62) --- ### Destination 7: Hangzhou - **Typical Nightly Budget Stay:** - **Dorm bed:** **¥65** (~$9.15 USD / ~€8.40) per night *(Evidence: Hangzhou West Lake Youth Hostel; Mingtown Hangzhou International Youth Hostel)*. - **Private budget double room:** **¥160** (~$22.50 USD) per night. - **Low-Cost Daily Food Estimate:** **¥55** (~$7.75 USD / ~€7.10) per day. - *Breakfast:* Shengjianbao (pan-fried pork buns) + soy milk: **¥10** - *Lunch:* Pian'erchuan noodles (hand-pulled noodles with preserved mustard greens, sliced bamboo shoots, and lean pork): **¥18** - *Dinner:* Traditional Jiangnan street diner or Zhiweiguan fast-casual meal: **¥27** - **Representative Activities & Sights:** 1. *West Lake Scenic Area Promenade:* **Free (¥0)** *(walking or cycling around Su Causeway; optional classic ferry boat to "Three Pools Mirroring the Moon" island is ¥45)*. 2. *Lingyin Temple & Feilai Peak:* **¥75** total *(Feilai Peak rock carvings admission ¥45 + Lingyin Temple ticket ¥30)*. 3. *Longjing (Dragon Well) Tea Village & China National Tea Museum:* **Free (¥0)** *(tea tasting optional at ¥25–40)*. - **Local Transit:** ~¥12/day (Subway) = **¥24** for 2 days. - **Hangzhou 2-Night Subtotal (Dorm Backpacker):** **¥384** (~$54 USD / ~€50) --- ### Destination 8: Shanghai - **Typical Nightly Budget Stay:** - **Dorm bed:** **¥80** (~$11.25 USD / ~€10.40) per night *(Evidence: Mingtown People's Square Youth Hostel; Captain Hostel on the Bund; Blue Mountain Bund Youth Hostel)*. - **Private budget double room:** **¥220** (~$31 USD) per night. - **Low-Cost Daily Food Estimate:** **¥65** (~$9.15 USD / ~€8.40) per day. - *Breakfast:* Shengjianbao (4 pcs) + Congyoubing (crispy scallion pancake): **¥12** - *Lunch:* Congyou banmian (scallion oil noodles) or shopping mall food court meal: **¥22** - *Dinner:* Shanghai canteen home-style dishes or Xiao Long Bao basket: **¥31** - **Representative Activities & Sights:** 1. *The Bund Promenade & Nanjing Road Pedestrian Walk:* **Free (¥0)** *(unrivaled night view of the Lujiazui skyscraper skyline across the river)*. 2. *Yu Garden (Yuyuan Classical Garden):* **¥40** (Peak: Apr 1 – Jun 30, Sep 1 – Nov 30) / **¥30** (Off-peak). 3. *Shanghai Tower 118th Floor Observation Deck:* **¥180** *(or Shanghai Museum on People's Square: Free with online booking)*. - **Local Transit:** ~¥15/day (Shanghai Metro) = **¥45** for 3 days. - **Shanghai 3-Night Subtotal (Dorm Backpacker):** **¥700** (~$99 USD / ~€91) --- ## 3.
